content.title: Quantum computing is on a roll: Top stock picks
content.description:
Quantum stocks, like Rigetti (RGTI), D-Wave (QBTS), and IonQ (IONQ), have been surging over the past few days.

Benchmark Company managing director of equity research in semiconductors, David Williams, joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to discuss some of his top stock picks in the quantum computing space.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
